items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Like Billie Holliday was always a pleasure to play with, if she was feeling well

ctx.x: I was always a guy that liked to play jazz. We wanted to play jazz. And we didn't mind playing for singers, really, who we thought were good. Like Billie Holliday was always a pleasure to play with, if she was feeling well, and, you know -- but you know, it just was a thing you did as a chore.
